scripts.check: pnpm --filter @brr/asset-pipeline restore-ldraw && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:boundaries && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:infra && pnpm check:rust && pnpm --filter @brr/asset-pipeline section-vocabulary --check && turbo run typecheck test build && pnpm e2e
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check:infra: terraform -chdir=infra/cloudflare fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infra/cloudflare init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly && terraform -chdir=infra/cloudflare validate
